Normal/200% text screenshots show Duration(seconds)/RPE(1-10) labels with restored26/7 values. The earlier all-sets assertion stopped before scrolling to the fields. Bulk voice input was intercepted by an observed Gboard stylus tutorial; after its Cancel, exact paced text passes. These harness/IME interruptions remain documented; no app text-loss defect inferred. This is scoped label and floating/stylus-IME evidence, not all-field, docked-keyboard, successful recognition, physical/iOS or human acceptance.

Keep this issue open for its remaining acceptance criteria. Score remains53/100. Report/screenshots and exact Android launch instructions: https://github.com/camster91/Shift6/blob/0b997f90ff43370a655830eb72c3494a665d0a7f/docs/52_NATIVE_ACCESSIBILITY_AND_LABELS_QA.md
